description: A minecraft mod focusing on optimizing smaller performance issues.

mods.name: Blindspot
mods.description: Fixes small, overlooked client-side performance issues that larger optimization mods don't cover.

releases.notes:
## Blindspot 0.4.0 for Minecraft 26.1

From this release on, every Minecraft version uses the same naming: the Minecraft version is appended to the mod version as build metadata (`0.4.0+26.1`), including the latest Minecraft version.

### New
- **Boat status optimization:** Every tick, vanilla scans the fluids and block collision shapes around each boat to work out whether it is in water, under water, on land or in the air. This also happens for parked boats and boats moved by the server. Blindspot now reuses the last result while the boat's bounding box is exactly the same and none of the chunks around it changed. Blocks whose collision shape can change without a block change (pistons, shulker boxes, scaffolding and other blocks vanilla marks as having a dynamic shape) are never cached. The result is always the same as in vanilla.
- The cache verification mode (`-Dblindspot.verifyCaches=true`) now also covers the boat status cache.

### Requirements
- Minecraft 26.1, 26.1.1 or 26.1.2
- Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer
- Fabric API is not required.

### Compatibility
- Mods that completely replace the vanilla sidebar, tab list or boat code may conflict with it. In that case the game usually crashes at startup instead of showing wrong results. Please open an issue with your log if this happens.

releases.notes:
## Blindspot 0.3.0 for Minecraft 26.1

First release of Blindspot for Minecraft 26.1. It works on 26.1, 26.1.1 and 26.1.2 and shares its mod version with the 26.2 and 26.3 releases; the Minecraft version is appended as build metadata (`0.3.0+26.1`).

### Features
- **Scoreboard sidebar optimization:** The sorted sidebar entries are cached instead of scanning and sorting every score on every frame. With large scoreboards (about 5,000 entries in testing) the sidebar went from about 0.9–1.3 ms to about 0.06–0.08 ms per frame.
- **Tab list optimization:** The player order in the tab list is cached instead of re-sorting all players on every frame while the list is open. It is only rebuilt when players join or leave the list, game mode or list order changes, or team membership changes.
- **Cache verification mode:** Start the game with `-Dblindspot.verifyCaches=true` to compare every cache hit against the vanilla result and log any mismatches. This is only meant for testing and bug reports, because it makes the game slower.

The friends list optimization from the 26.2 and 26.3 releases is not included, because Minecraft 26.1 has no friends list.

### Requirements
- Minecraft 26.1, 26.1.1 or 26.1.2
- Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer
- Fabric API is not required.

### Compatibility
- Mods that completely replace the vanilla sidebar or tab list code may conflict with it. In that case the game usually crashes at startup instead of showing wrong results. Please open an issue with your log if this happens.

releases.notes:
## Blindspot 0.3.0 for Minecraft 26.2

Brings Minecraft 26.2 up to the same feature set as the 26.3 release. From now on both Minecraft versions share one mod version; the Minecraft version is appended as build metadata (e.g. `0.3.0+26.2`).

### New
- **Scoreboard sidebar optimization:** The sorted sidebar entries are now cached instead of scanning and sorting every score on every frame. With large scoreboards (about 5,000 entries in testing) the sidebar went from about 0.9–1.3 ms to about 0.06–0.08 ms per frame.
- **Tab list optimization:** The player order in the tab list is now cached instead of re-sorting all players on every frame while the list is open. It is only rebuilt when players join or leave the list, game mode or list order changes, or team membership changes.
- **Cache verification mode:** Start the game with `-Dblindspot.verifyCaches=true` to compare every cache hit against the vanilla result and log any mismatches. This is only meant for testing and bug reports, because it makes the game slower.

### Changed
- **Fabric API is no longer required.** Blindspot now only needs Fabric Loader. If you still have Fabric API installed, you can keep it.
- Requires Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer (previously 0.19.3).
- The friends list cache now works on exactly the list vanilla read, so it can't pick up a mismatched result while the friends list is being updated in the background.

### Compatibility
- Mods that completely replace the vanilla sidebar or tab list code may conflict with it. In that case the game usually crashes at startup instead of showing wrong results. Please open an issue with your log if this happens.
